versions.name: Newport Sea Base

features.note: Progressive youth sailing from beginner dinghies through advanced classes, plus big-boat sailing and a junior racing team.
A named rowing programme running from Learn to Row through a competitive high-school team.
Learning to handle a motor boat around the harbour.
An on-site aquarium and hermit crab exhibit, touch tanks with rays and sharks, oceanography, and dissections.
Design-and-build workshops, robotics, engineering, and underwater drone exploration.
A harbour-front aquatics centre on Newport Bay.

versions.summary: Orange County Council's aquatics high-adventure base on Newport Harbor, offering sailing, rowing, kayaking, fishing, oceanography, and STEM programs for youth.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
